ESHAN KUTHU 
 706.373.5784 • kuthu.eshan@gmail.com • Fortworth, Texas 
Skilled  software  developer  with  9  years  of  excellent  experience  contributing  to  back-end  and  front-end  programming  in  a  complex 
development  environment.  Adept  at  using  SDLC  principles  to  optimize  the  development  process  and  enhance  overall  application 
outcomes.  Skilled  at  implementing  web  applications  through  complete  SDLC  using  development  processes;  adept  at  delivering  on 
client  requirements  for  web  development  projects  for  international  customers.  Strong  history  of  implementing  web  applications  using 
web services, design patterns, and the latest frameworks. 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
Javascript Programming · Web Application Development · Requirements Gathering & Analysis · Application Design 
Code Quality / Software Testing · Troubleshooting & Debugging · Team Collaboration · Technical Integration 
Languages:      JavaScript , Java, Typescript

Client: Schneider • 2022 April 20th - 2024 
Tasks Performed: 
●
Developed a real time microservice to determine status and locations for the existing assets in the company across USA, Mexico 
and   Canada, receiving events from multiple sources and systems like GPS devices, RAIL EDI, Apps, etc .(NodeJs, React, SQL, 
Oracle, Mongo) 
●
Engaged and contributed comprehensively across the entire software development life cycle, encompassing design, development, 
testing, deployment, and maintenance phases 
●
Designed  and  structured  workflows,  databases,  and  systems,  overseeing  their  architectural  frameworks  and  implementations  to 
ensure efficiency and scalability. 
●
Designed and developed a microservice to retire a legacy product, architecting an efficient process flow spanning across multiple

ensure efficiency and scalability. 
●
Designed and developed a microservice to retire a legacy product, architecting an efficient process flow spanning across multiple  
systems, leveraging AWS cloud services such as S3, EC2, Lambda, Route53, API Gateway, contributing to cloud-based application 
deployment and management. 
Resume

●
Designed  and  developed  a  real  time  interactive  map  to  show  the  status  and  location  of  hundreds  of  thousands  of  devices  with 
several geospatial filters, traffic analysis, and weather alerts. 
●
Redesigned and developed the UI  for an application to show the existing locations of customers in the company creating reusable 
components and creating an internal grid system based on flexbox. 
●
Designed  and  developed  a  real-time  springboot  microservice  to  capture  and  process  truck  event  data,  including  video  streams 
triggered  by  incidents  (e.g.,  hard  braking  or  accidents). The  system  integrates  event  detection,  video  analysis,  and  classification, 
automatically uploading videos to AWS S3, enabling secure streaming, and applying lifecycle rules for automated cleanup, thereby 
optimizing storage, cost, and data retention. 
●

automatically uploading videos to AWS S3, enabling secure streaming, and applying lifecycle rules for automated cleanup, thereby 
optimizing storage, cost, and data retention. 
●
Demonstrated  competence  in  a  wide  array  of  emerging  and  traditional  technologies,  encompassing  SpringBoot,  REST,  JSON, 
HTML5, CSS, NGINX, Express, Docker, NoSQL databases, and Git. 
●
Utilized Jenkins for streamlining continuous integration processes, ensuring efficient application deployment and maintenance. 
        
Technologies:  Angular, NodeJS, Express, Typescript, MongoDb, NoSQL, Docker, AWS, Playwright, Springboot 
Client: HubGroup • 2018 June 28 - 2022 April 15th 
HubGroup is a transportation management company in North America, providing intermodal, truck brokerage and logistics services. 
Tasks Performed: 
●
Optimized  MongoDB  queries  under  high  load  by  employing  aggregation  pipelines,  strategic  index  creation  (including  compound,

Tasks Performed: 
●
Optimized  MongoDB  queries  under  high  load  by  employing  aggregation  pipelines,  strategic  index  creation  (including  compound, 
unique, and TTL indexes), and refined query construction for maximum performance scalability. Engineered resilient data models 
to effectively manage unstructured IoT messages. 
●
Developed  an  application  to  determine  pricing  on  specific  zones  defined  by  customers  where  containers  delivering  freights, 
implementint  a  bulk  upload  for  thousands  of  records,  approval  workflows,  user  roles,  business  logic  and  notifications.(Mongo, 
Express, TypeScript, Angular  and NodeJS) 
●
Migrated a third party application saving the company 1 million annually consisting of 100+ microservices, 4 databases, and 1000+ 
customers  all  onto  company  infrastructure.  Utilized  AWS  EKS  to  manage  our  kubernetes  cluster  with  multiple  nodes  for  fault

customers  all  onto  company  infrastructure.  Utilized  AWS  EKS  to  manage  our  kubernetes  cluster  with  multiple  nodes  for  fault 
tolerance  and  high  availability,  AWS  RDS  to  manage  our  PostgreSQL  instance,  and  AWS  Cloudwatch  for  observability  and 
monitoring all of which was spread across multiple availability zones for high resiliency.  
●
Developed an application where customers can approve or reject rates for the requested lanes to move a freight using the assets 
of the company. 
●
Ensured high availability and resilience through Docker health checks and fault-tolerant mechanisms across all microservices. 
●
Contributed  comprehensively  to  the  software  development  life  cycle,  including  the  architectural  design,  development,  testing, 
deployment, and maintenance phases. 
●
Architected workflows, databases, and systems, emphasizing efficiency and scalability in their designs.
